The composed and protocol hashes were computed directly through core.config.compose / core.config.protocol_hash -- the same functions check uses -- and the method was verified against four sealed registered values. The coordinator's re-pin cycle runs check on the clean registration commit and asserts the runtime-derived hashes agree.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster, role-graph, prompt, geometry or cap change, and no silent recovery. At most one root-diagnosed recovery re-registration; a second failure closes this flight and the fix must be proven on a four-row dry run before another mechanism is admitted. A partial manifest is never scored and never read. One experiment in flight at a time.
